name: Snoot Game
source:
You play as Anon, a lonely, faceless, nobody, reject who finds himself in the dinosaur themed acid trip of a school named Volcano High. Here Anon meets the qt ptero known as Fang and their clown-vomit colored posse of reject friends and other associated thorns-in-the-side. All of whom, you can read about here.

This game is a parody of [url=https://vndb.org/v46861]Goodbye Volcano High[/url].

[Edited from [url=https://snootgame.xyz/]official website[/url]]
translation:
你扮演Anon，一个孤独、不露面、无人问津的人，发现自己身处一所名为火山高中的学校的恐龙主题迷幻之旅中。在这里，阿农遇到了被称为“Fang”的qt ptero以及他们那群被拒绝的朋友和其他相关的眼中钉。所有这些人，你都可以在这里阅读。

这个游戏是对[url=https://vndb.org/v46861]再见火山高中[/url]的模仿。

[编辑自[url=https://snootgame.xyz/]官网[/url]]
